svg.text: Qwen3-VL-2B language model (28 layers, frozen + LoRA r=32 on all linear layers)
one causal forward pass · foresight tokens see images, task and state · action queries additionally see the foresight tokens
Loss = L1(actions) + 0.5 · MSE(imagined, LN(target)). At test time no future frame is needed: the model imagines t+8 and acts on it in the same pass.
The target lives in the token space the LLM already reads images in, so no pixel decoder is needed and the world model costs one extra no-grad vision pass.
